t1.name: Sarah M.
t1.text: I tried three apps before this. ThaiMastery is the only one that got me actually talking to my neighbours within a month. The daily plan removes all decision fatigue.

t2.name: Lukas B.
t2.text: The reading course is incredible. I went from zero to reading street signs and menus in six weeks. The tracing exercises make the alphabet stick.

t3.name: Camille R.
t3.text: The AI conversation partner is a game changer — I can practise ordering food at midnight without embarrassment. Passed my Level 9 exam on day 54!

q1.q: How much time do I need per day?
q1.a: Only 15–20 minutes. The platform automatically prepares a daily plan with a lesson, vocabulary, speaking, listening and a quick review — sized to fit a coffee break.

q2.q: Can I really speak Thai in 60 days?
q2.a: Yes — conversationally. Our 9-level speaking course covers the 1,000 most useful words and phrases. You won't debate philosophy, but you will shop, order, travel and make friends in Thai.

q3.q: Do I need to learn the Thai script?
q3.a: Not for speaking — the speaking course uses romanised pronunciation throughout. The separate Reading & Writing course teaches the script from zero if you want the full experience.

q4.q: What happens if I fail a level exam?
q4.a: Nothing bad! You can retake exams as often as you like. You need 80% to unlock the next level, which guarantees you build on solid foundations.

q5.a: Yes. Each course ends with a final exam. Pass it and you can download an official, printable PDF certificate with a unique verification number.

q6.a: Anytime, in one click from your settings. Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically until cancelled; the lifetime plan is a single payment, forever.
